categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main segments: consumer electronics structural modules and precision molds, focusing on R&D, design, production, and sales; and photovoltaic (PV) industry, including efficient PV module production, PV power station projects, integrated energy storage manufacturing, and new energy project solutions and services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as high-temperature rapid molding, in-mold decoration, two-color injection molding, glass fiber molding, stamping and thickening techniques, vacuum coating, and automated assembly lines. It also employs CNC automation, non-contact rapid measurement, and smart energy management systems for photovoltaic and energy storage products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global notebook computer OEMs such as Lianbao, Renbao, Weichuang, and Huaqin, serving leading notebook brands like Lenovo, Dell, Xiaomi, Acer, HP, and emerging brands like Honor. The company also serves the photovoltaic market with products used in distributed and commercial PV power stations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with manufacturing bases in Anhui, Jiangsu, and Chongqing, and has expanded overseas with subsidiaries in the United States, Vietnam, and Hong Kong. Its sales cover domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of revenue from exports.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the supply chain, focusing on the design, mold manufacturing, and production of structural modules and photovoltaic components, supplying to OEMs and system integrators in consumer electronics and renewable energy sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening core business in notebook structural modules, expanding photovoltaic industry chain involvement, enhancing R&D investment, advancing automation and digital transformation, and developing integrated energy storage solutions. The company emphasizes innovation in product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and smart energy management platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of structural modules, precision molds, photovoltaic modules, and related engineering services. The company also earns income from photovoltaic power generation and project sales, with a focus on contract-based manufacturing and EPC services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in notebook structural modules, competing with firms like Juteng International, Shengli Precision, Chunqiu Electronics, and Tongda Hongtai. It holds a strong position due to comprehensive service capabilities from mold design to module production and stable partnerships with major OEMs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.84 billion, a 24.18% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 10.27 million, reversing previous losses. Total assets reached RMB 2.96 billion, growing 19.09%, supported by increased cash flows and expanded borrowing for business growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through integrated one-stop services covering design, mold manufacturing, and module production, rapid response capabilities, advanced manufacturing technologies, and strong customer relationships with global OEMs. Its photovoltaic business leverages in-house production and project development to enhance efficiency and control, emphasizing quality, innovation, and sustainability.
